description: This file is a PHP-based web page used for editing a port forwarding rule in a network management interface. It includes server-side code to retrieve current configuration data, as well as client-side JavaScript for form validation and dynamic UI behavior, handling input for both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, port ranges, and service types.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address with possible zero compression (::) notation into an array of its segments.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if any input fields with a given prefix are non-empty, ignoring specific fields.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates multiple input field values with a separator to form an address string.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address input is required based on whether related fields are blank.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address input is required based on whether related fields are blank.
